def squash: ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z]"; "");

. as $in
| $in.ret as $r
| [
    ($in.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
    | to_entries[]
    | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$"))
    | {n: (.key | tonumber), c: (.value.run_check.result? // null)}
    | select(.c != null)
  ]
| sort_by(.n)
| map(.c) as $checks
| ($in.oath | if type == "object" then .oath else null end
    | if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:300] else null end) as $oath
| ($oath != null) as $received
| ($received and (($oath | squash) == ($r.oathText | squash))) as $exact
| ($r.seed % 10) as $roll
| {
    code: (if ($received | not) then "DENIED"
           elif $roll <= 4 then "APPROVED_REFUND"
           elif $roll <= 7 then "STORE_CREDIT"
           else "DENIED" end),
    denialGround: (if ($received | not) then "NO_OATH" else "POLICY" end),
    oath: {received: $received, exact: $exact, text: $oath},
    checks: $checks,
    checksRun: ($checks | length),
    checksPassed: ($checks | map(select(.verdict | startswith("PASS"))) | length),
    checksConsulted: 0
  }

workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce returns. Runs six pointless checks with a pause after each, waits a bounded time for the customer's Returns Oath, then decides: refund, store credit or denial. The oath wait ends by itself, so an abandoned return is still decided. Uses only system tasks. If it fails or times out, chaos_returns_default_decision approves the return by default.
workflowDefinition.name: chaos_returns

    explanation: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then "Against all odds your return was approved. Your refund has been calculated below, fees included."
                  elif $code == "DENIED" then $denial.ground
                  else "We would rather not part with actual money, so please enjoy this store credit instead." end),
    refund: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then $refund else null end),
    credit: (if $code == "STORE_CREDIT"
      then ($credit // {
        creditCents: $r.item.priceCents,
        creditCode: "SORRY-\($r.seed)",
        terms: "Worth the item price. Valid until we notice."
      })
      else null end),
    denial: (if $code == "DENIED" then $denial else null end),
    oath: $v.oath,
    checks: $v.checks,
    checksRun: $v.checksRun,
    checksPassed: $v.checksPassed,
    checksConsulted: 0,
    footnote: "\($v.checksRun) checks were run. \($v.checksPassed) passed. 0 were consulted in reaching this decision."
  }
